summary: LightPath Technologies filed a prospectus supplement for a combined primary and secondary offering of 3,571,400 shares of Class A common stock each at $14.00 per share, priced at a ~17.5% discount to the last sale price of $16.98 on May 29, 2026. The primary offering is expected to raise ~$47.7M net to the company; the secondary offering proceeds go to the selling stockholder. Craig-Hallum acts as placement agent on a best-efforts basis. The filing is a routine capital raise under Rule 424(b)(5), not a special situation. What to watch: potential dilution from the primary shares; no special-situation event.
